management_notes: Churchill appointed a new CEO in May 2026, bringing fresh leadership during a critical phase of Black Raven's exploration buildout. The team moves quickly on the ground: Golden Baie option signed Feb/Mar 2026, Fall 2026 drill program announced promptly after spring results. A correction to the March 2026 Frost Cove drill release (issued May 2026) flags internal data compilation issues that warrant monitoring — the error was self-identified and corrected, which is better than concealment, but it underscores early-stage process risk. Insider ownership not publicly quantified. Score reflects functional but unproven stewardship.
geology_notes: Black Raven is developing as a structurally controlled, high-grade antimony system with polymetallic upside. Best intercept: 7.25% Sb over 1.98m near the Southern Shaft along an 800m strike (corrected). The vein swarm at Pomley Cove Pond extends over a 150m-wide corridor and returns gold, silver, lead, zinc, and molybdenum — confirming system complexity but complicating the antimony story. Nine additional 2026 drill holes were completed before the Aug 28 announcement, with assays pending. Fall 2026 program targets full PVS strike continuity via extensions to PC26-03 and PC26-16. No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists. Grade quality is genuine; size and continuity remain unproven.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares issued as of the April 2026 MD&A, fully diluted approximately 342.8M (including 23.45M options and 2.625M warrants; strike prices and expiries not extracted from the MD&A summary table). Share count is large for a pre-resource explorer at ~$0.055, implying a market cap of ~$17.4M but severe dilution risk on any financing at current price levels. Warrant overhang is modest at 2.625M. The 23.45M option book is more significant relative to float. No flow-through tranches detected in the extracted April 2026 MD&A filing. Capital efficiency depends heavily on how many more drill holes are required before a maiden resource can be filed.
catalyst_notes: Multiple near-term catalysts: (1) assay results from nine 2026 drill holes completed before the August 28 announcement — could arrive any time in Q4 2026; (2) Fall 2026 drill program extending holes PC26-03 and PC26-16 across the full Pomley–Vein Swarm horizon, results expected Q4 2026 or Q1 2027; (3) Golden Baie option, adding a second high-grade antimony-gold project in Newfoundland; (4) any critical mineral financing or provincial/federal support announcement. If the Fall holes demonstrate material strike continuity with improved widths, the resource pathway accelerates significantly.
acquisition_notes: No resource estimate exists, making a formal P/NAV comparison impossible at this time. Strategic optionality is real: antimony is a designated critical mineral in Canada, Newfoundland is permitting-friendly, and the polymetallic nature of Black Raven could attract multiple buyer types (antimony strategics, gold royalty companies, government-backed critical mineral vehicles). The asset is at minimum 12–18 months from a resource that would support a defensible valuation floor. At current stage the acquisition thesis is an option on what Black Raven becomes, not a present-day calculation. Comparable early-stage antimony juniors trade at $15–50M market caps; CRI is at the low end of that range but without the resource backing.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is an active antimony explorer running a systematic drill campaign at Black Raven, central Newfoundland. The grade quality is real — 7.25% Sb at Frost Cove North is genuine high-tenor antimony — but no NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, widths are narrow, the Q1 2026 results required a correction, and the share count is large for the stage. The macro thesis (antimony as a Western critical mineral with accelerating demand from flame retardants, batteries, and defence applications) remains intact and could compress the timeline to a valuation event. Fall 2026 drill results — covering full PVS strike continuity — are the pivotal near-term catalyst. Strong continuity with improved widths would justify revisiting as a conditional BUY. Until then, WATCH.
